items.source: Making a BeanFactory available is optional; if not set, JmsListenerConfigurer beans won't get autodetected and an endpoint registry has to be explicitly configured.
items.translation: 使 `BeanFactory` 可用是可选的；如果不设置，`JmsListenerConfigurer` Bean 将不会被自动检测，并且必须显式配置一个 `endpoint registry`。

items.source: Instantiate an empty MethodJmsListenerEndpoint for further configuration with provided parameters in processJmsListener(JmsListener, Method, Object).
items.translation: 实例化一个空的MethodJmsListenerEndpoint，以便在processJmsListener(JmsListener, Method, Object)中使用提供的参数进行进一步配置。

items.source: Process the given JmsListener annotation on the given method, registering a corresponding endpoint for the given bean instance.
items.translation: 处理给定方法上的 `JmsListener` 注解，并为给定的 Bean 实例注册相应的端点。

items.source: Set the JmsListenerEndpointRegistry that will hold the created endpoint and manage the lifecycle of the related listener container.
items.translation: 设置将保存创建的端点并管理相关监听器容器生命周期的JmsListenerEndpointRegistry。

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean
items.translation: beanName - 豆子的名称

items.source: Autodetects any JmsListenerConfigurer instances in the container, allowing for customization of the registry to be used, the default container factory or for fine-grained control over endpoints registration. See the EnableJms javadocs for complete usage details.
items.translation: 自动检测容器中的任何 `JmsListenerConfigurer` 实例，允许自定义要使用的注册表、默认容器工厂，或实现对端点注册的细粒度控制。有关完整的使用说明，请参阅 `EnableJms` 的 JavaDoc。

items.source: By default, DefaultMessageHandlerMethodFactory is used and it can be configured further to support additional method arguments or to customize conversion and validation support. See DefaultMessageHandlerMethodFactory Javadoc for more details.
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用 DefaultMessageHandlerMethodFactory，并且可以对其进行进一步配置以支持额外的方法参数或自定义转换和验证支持。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 DefaultMessageHandlerMethodFactory 的 Javadoc。

items.source: This post-processor is automatically registered by Spring's <jms:annotation-driven> XML element, and also by the EnableJms annotation.
items.translation: 此后置处理器由 Spring 的 `` XML 元素自动注册，同时也由 `EnableJms` 注解自动注册。

items.source: Annotated methods can use flexible arguments as defined by JmsListener.
items.translation: 注释方法可以使用由JmsListener定义的灵活参数。

items.source: The default implementation returns the given bean as-is.
items.translation: 默认实现原样返回给定的bean。

items.source: If none is specified, "jmsListenerContainerFactory" is assumed to be defined.
items.translation: 如果未指定，则假定已定义"jmsListenerContainerFactory"。

items.source: Set the name of the JmsListenerContainerFactory to use by default.
items.translation: 将默认使用的JmsListenerContainerFactory的名称设置好。

items.source: Set the MessageHandlerMethodFactory to use to configure the message listener responsible to serve an endpoint detected by this processor.
items.translation: 将 `MessageHandlerMethodFactory` 设置为用于配置由该处理器检测到的端点所负责的消息监听器。

items.source: Post-process the given merged bean definition for the specified bean.
items.translation: 对指定 Bean 的合并后的 Bean 定义进行后处理。

items.source: NOTE: This callback won't be triggered for singleton beans lazily initialized on demand after BeanFactory bootstrap, and not for any other bean scope either. Carefully use it for beans with the intended bootstrap semantics only.
items.translation: 注意：此回调不会为在 BeanFactory 引导后按需懒式初始化的单例 Bean 触发，也不会为任何其他 Bean 作用域触发。请仅针对具有预期引导语义的 Bean 谨慎使用它。

items.source: This callback will also be invoked after a short-circuiting triggered by a InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String) method, in contrast to all other BeanPostProcessor callbacks.
items.translation: 此回调也会在由InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String)方法触发的短路之后被调用，这与所有其他BeanPostProcessor回调不同。

items.source: Higher values are interpreted as lower priority. As a consequence, the object with the lowest value has the highest priority (somewhat analogous to Servlet load-on-startup values).
items.translation: 较高的值被解释为较低的优先级。因此，具有最低值的对象具有最高的优先级（类似于 Servlet 的 `load-on-startup` 值）。

items.source: In case of a FactoryBean, this callback will be invoked for both the FactoryBean instance and the objects created by the FactoryBean. The post-processor can decide whether to apply to either the FactoryBean or created objects or both through corresponding bean instanceof FactoryBean checks.
items.translation: 对于 FactoryBean，此回调将针对 FactoryBean 实例以及由 FactoryBean 创建的对象均被调用。后处理器可以通过相应的 `bean instanceof FactoryBean` 检查来决定是应用于 FactoryBean、创建的对象还是两者。

items.source:
Same order values will result in arbitrary sort positions for the
affected objects.
items.translation: 相同的顺序值将导致受影响的对象具有任意的排序位置。

items.source: Apply this BeanPostProcessor to the given new bean instance after any bean initialization callbacks (like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet or a custom init-method).
items.translation: 将此 `BeanPostProcessor` 应用于给定的新 Bean 实例，且是在任何 Bean 初始化回调（例如 `InitializingBean` 的 `afterPropertiesSet` 或自定义的 init-method）之后。
